description: This file defines the DelegatorElement class which models the <delegator> XML element in OFBiz entity configuration. It parses and stores various configuration attributes and child elements related to the delegator's setup.

classes.name: DelegatorElement
classes.description: Models the <delegator> configuration element, provides access to its attributes and child <group-map> elements.

methods.name: DelegatorElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing a <delegator> XML element and extracting its attributes and child elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the delegator.

methods.name: getEntityEcaEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether entity-eca-enabled is true or false.

methods.name: getEntityEcaHandlerClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name for the entity ECA handler.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether distributed cache clear is enabled.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name for distributed cache clearing.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearUserLoginId
methods.description: Returns the user login ID used for cache clearing.

methods.name: getGroupMapList
methods.description: Returns the list of GroupMap objects representing <group-map> elements.

methods.name: getGroupDataSource
methods.description: Returns the datasource name for a given group name.
